questions.subject: DISCRETE_MATHEMATICS_II
questions.learningObjective: Solve an exam-level problem in discrete mathematics from first principles.
questions.stem: Which is equivalent to the negation of forall x, P(x)?
questions.explanation: Negating a universal statement gives an existential statement with the predicate negated: there exists x with not P(x). Keeping the universal quantifier does not negate the claim.
questions.hint: Flip the quantifier and negate the predicate.
